# compute_domain_stopwords { #dyf.compute_domain_stopwords }

```python
compute_domain_stopwords(titles, threshold=0.1)
```

Words appearing in >threshold fraction of titles. Corpus-level stop words.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                           | Description                                                                                                          | Default    |
|-----------|--------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| titles    | [list](`list`)\[[str](`str`)\] | List of title strings.                                                                                               | _required_ |
| threshold | [float](`float`)               | Fraction threshold (0.0-1.0). Words appearing in more than this fraction of titles are considered domain stop words. | `0.1`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                         | Description                               |
|--------|------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
|        | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] | Set of domain-specific stop word strings. |
